evals.prompt: Use untangle to survey this repo. I'm not a developer, so keep it plain. I think it got messy because I kept trying ideas in the same folder.
evals.expected_output: Survey mode. The session runs the bundled scan helper rather than eyeballing the tree, states the spine in one sentence from the README (a command-line note-taking app), and sorts the rest into threads with file evidence: the web server with two frameworks contradicts the spine, the experiments/ai-summarizer and old/ directories are abandoned (stale, sentinel-named, unreferenced), the README promises bin/notely and scripts/install.sh which do not exist, .eslintrc.json has no eslint dependency, and a .env file is committed. It writes UNTANGLE.md with those threads marked pending, reports on roughly one screen in plain language, and ends by asking about exactly one thread with a recommendation. No other file is changed.

expectations: The bundled scan helper (scripts/untangle.py scan) was executed before findings were reported.
The spine is stated as one sentence identifying a command-line note-taking app, citing README.md or package.json.

The web server thread (src/server, express plus fastify) is reported as contradicting the spine, and experiments/ai-summarizer and old/ are reported as abandoned or set aside, each with its file paths as evidence.

At least two of these concrete signals are reported: the README promises bin/notely or scripts/install.sh which do not exist; the cli script points at a missing src/cli.js; .eslintrc.json exists without an eslint dependency; .env is committed.

UNTANGLE.md is created at the repository root with a spine section and a threads table whose non-spine decisions are pending, and no other repository file is modified, moved, or deleted (the temporary .untangle-scan.json may be created and removed).
The response ends by asking about exactly one thread with a recommended decision, not a batch of questions, and no thread is recorded as parked or deleted without the user's answer.
The report is written in plain language without unexplained jargon and does not invent findings absent from the repository.

evals.prompt: Run untangle survey on this project.
evals.expected_output: Negative control for fabrication. The repository is small and coherent: one CLI, a test, a lockfile, an ignore file. The session states the spine, reports that the project hangs together, finds no abandoned or contradicting threads, records no foundations finding, and either writes a short plan whose roadmap says nothing obvious or says no plan is needed. It does not invent stale, duplicate, or contradiction findings and does not start a long decision interview.

evals.expected_output: Scope stop. A single-commit bug review is not a whole-repository coherence survey. The session says in a line or two that untangle is for surveying a sprawling repository, points to the host's code review tool for a diff review, and does nothing else: no scan run, no UNTANGLE.md, no file changes.

setup_turns: Use untangle to survey this repository. I am not a developer; keep the report short and plain.
Park the web server. I might want a web view later but it is not the point right now.
Delete the AI summarizer experiment. Park the old folder.
evals.prompt: Those are all my decisions. Finish the plan and tell me what to do next.
evals.expected_output: Multi-turn survey to a finished plan. Across the setup turns the session surveyed, wrote UNTANGLE.md with pending decisions, and asked one thread at a time. On the final turn it records the decisions (web server parked, summarizer deleted, old/ parked, all attributed to the user), writes the ordered checklist with hygiene first (the committed .env) then park and delete items with paths and verifications, fills the foundations section (at most three decision-level rows or None), and writes the roadmap with exactly one Next citing a thread or finding, a short Then list, and Parked ideas listing exactly the two parked threads. The helper's plan check passes. It tells the user to commit the plan and how to start apply. No checklist item is executed.
